1. The original pod "backend-76d98d6cb7-wmq8l" tried to pull "nginx:latst" (typo - should be "nginx:latest")
2. A new replica set "backend-8b6c7d94b" was created, which also has the same typo
3. The working pod is "backend-76d98d6cb7-pfsl2" which uses the correct "nginx:latest"

Let me check the deployment to understand the configuration:Perfect! I've found the issue:

**DIAGNOSIS:** The deployment has an image typo: "nginx:latst" instead of "nginx:latest". The pod is trying to pull a non-existent image, causing an ImagePullBackOff error.

**FIX:** I'll patch the deployment to use the correct image:Perfect! The fix has been applied.

## Summary

**DIAGNOSIS:** The original pod "backend-76d98d6cb7-wmq8l" failed because the deployment had an image typo - "nginx:latst" instead of "nginx:latest". This caused an ImagePullBackOff error.

**FIX:** Applied a kubectl patch to the backend deployment to correct the image from "nginx:latst" to "nginx:latest":
```bash
kubectl patch deployment backend -n case12-double -p '{"spec":{"template":{"spec":{"containers":[{"name":"backend","image":"nginx:latest"}]}}}}'
```

This will trigger a rolling update of the deployment, which will create new pods with the correct image.
